posts.name: stevelabny
posts.cooked:
I came for the errata cards, I figured I'd get the empty expansion box for shelving reasons, I saw Mr. Chomps. I thought he looked cool but I wasn't convinced he'd be high quality. There's a lot of stuffed animals in my living room and the gf and I have high standards (once you go Cuddlekins, you don't go back).  Wasn't sure if he was soft enough, wasn't sure if he'd be stitched well enough, wasn't sure if he was big enough to be worth the price. Looked at him for an hour.

But he's a plush robot t-rex so I decided to stop kidding myself and ordered him.

 

He is awesome.

 

Soft to the touch, not over-stuffed, nicely detailed, nice shade of red.  I am extremely happy with my purchase.

 

My errata cards weren't in the box though. Maybe Mr. Chomps ate them?
